objective: Implement app/services/pdf_export.py exposing render_report_pdf(customer_id, lang) per C3: one PDF page per report of the customer (customer header + period/title/metric/value rows), report data fetched exclusively through app/queries.py, all label strings from the C4 tables, drawing through the C5 shim (injected; stubbed in this task's tests), plus unit tests including a page-count assertion.

concepts: report data shape from report_with_rows/reports_for_customer (id, customer_id, period, title, rows[{metric, value}])
dependency injection of the shim so tests stub it

frozen_contracts.spec: render_report_pdf(customer_id: str, lang: str) -> bytes — renders one PDF page per report of the customer, fetching report data exclusively via app/queries.py, labels from the C4 label tables for the given lang; returns a non-empty byte string starting with b'%PDF'.

label tables for pdf generation: LABELS = {'en': {customer, period, title, metric, value}, 'de': {Kunde, Periode, Titel, Kennzahl, Wert}} — exact key set {customer, period, title, metric, value}; renderer must not hardcode label strings outside these tables.

vendored pdflib_shim module at app/services/pdflib_shim.py exposing: open() -> doc, doc.add_page(), doc.add_text(x, y, text, size=10), doc.save() -> bytes — a ~40-line pure-stdlib wrapper producing a minimal valid PDF (header %PDF-1.4, pages, xref, trailer).

non_goals: no reading of _REPORTS / models.get_report directly (queries.py is the only data path)
no hardcoded label strings outside the C4 tables
no changes to app/queries.py or app/models.py
implementation_constraints: the public signature stays exactly the frozen 2-arg render_report_pdf(customer_id, lang); a private helper _render(customer_id, lang, shim) accepts the shim so tests call the helper with a recording stub implementing the C5 API
every label emitted must come from LABELS[lang][key] — a missing key must raise, not default
customer with zero reports -> raise LookupError (the API rejects such enqueues upstream per C1/A3)

acceptance_tests.description: render for customer c1 with a recording stub: exactly 2 add_page calls (one per report) and the page texts contain both report titles
lang='de' -> recorded texts contain the German labels (Kunde, Periode, Titel, Kennzahl, Wert); lang absent -> 'en' default with English labels
customer with no reports raises LookupError before any page is drawn
a report with zero rows still renders its page (the test asserts a title-only page, no metric rows)

failure_cases.expected_behavior: the page renders customer/period/title only (the test asserts title-only text)

failure_cases.scenario: label key missing from the table
failure_cases.expected_behavior: a KeyError is raised loudly (the test asserts no silent default text is drawn)

handoff.notes: tests use a recording stub of the C5 API (counts add_page, records add_text args); real-shim byte verification happens in the T07 e2e gates.
